findings.text: the flip lives in _record_landing_comment, which returns before its versioned write on three paths (empty_narrative at :3582, and the two worker_recorded returns at :3611 and :3641), so a first landing through any of them leaves the plan reading draft; the stated invariant holds only on the write path.
